jd.text:
Position: Senior AI Full Stack Developer
Location: Onsite - Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Duration: 1 year renewable

Role Overview:
Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI-powered applications, combining full stack engineering expertise with modern machine learning and LLM integration capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:
Build and maintain scalable web applications (frontend and backend)
Develop, integrate, and fine-tune AI/LLM solutions (RAG pipelines, chatbots, retrieval systems)
Design and manage APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure
Implement vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search solutions
Collaborate with data scientists, product owners, and stakeholders
Ensure security, performance, and code quality best practices
Deploy and monitor models and applications in production environments

Required Skills & Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
5+ years of full stack development experience
Proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript
Experience with frameworks such as React, Node.js, FastAPI/Django
Hands-on experience with LLMs, LangChain/LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Azure OpenAI APIs
Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Qdrant)
Strong knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, REST APIs, and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS)
Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in agile teams

Preferred:
Experience in banking/fintech domain
Knowledge of Shariah-compliant banking products
Arabic language proficiency
